description: This file defines the Poisson class which provides methods to compute Poisson distribution, including probability mass functions and cumulative distribution functions, as part of a spreadsheet calculation library.

classes.name: Poisson
classes.description: Provides static methods to calculate Poisson distribution probabilities and cumulative values within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Calculates the Poisson distribution value (probability mass function or cumulative distribution function) for a given value and mean. Supports array arguments for bulk calculations.
